trigger_evidence: Kael re-ran the corrected launcher. The Python runtime was discovered and the runner started, but it stopped before model download/video generation with URLError WinError 10061: connection refused to the local ComfyUI endpoint.

diagnosis.evidence: The runner targets http://127.0.0.1:8188. WinError 10061 means the local TCP connection was explicitly refused at the time of the API call. This is consistent with ComfyUI not remaining reachable on port 8188; it is not evidence of an LTX model failure.

next_safe_action: Start the already-existing ComfyUI manually with its existing run_nvidia_gpu.bat, wait until http://127.0.0.1:8188 is open/reachable, then rerun the same corrected UGC-VIDEO-001 launcher exactly once. Do not install software, custom nodes or another model.
